correctness.rationale: Exact one-node replacement identities follow from Lagrange cardinal uniqueness; the Lobatto angular formula has interior derivative weight n(-1)^j and endpoint twice that weight. The perturbed Lebesgue function at bounded angular offset u has harmonic coefficient (2/pi)|sin(pi u)| |1-tau/u|. The O(1) error is uniform on compact offsets by the 1/m^2+1/n estimates, and intact-grid control plus |L_k(z)| <= C/|u| excludes remote maximizers. The negative-offset profile is strictly concave on (0,1/2), has positive derivative at 0 and negative derivative at 1/2, while every competing positive/far offset is smaller. Therefore both asymptotic coefficient and concentration of all maximizing points follow. Independent nodal-product computations at n=500,2000,6000 for tau=.25,.5,.75 and bulk positions .32,.67 corroborated the predicted slow approach (finite-n additive constants persist); these are not proof of the limit.
